d:
Festivals in India are all about family, food and something sweet being made in the kitchen.
For me, there’s something really special about cooking for the people you love - the moments in the kitchen, the smell of something baking and then everyone coming together to share it.
Kyuki ghar banta hai un chhoti chhoti cheezon se jo hum apno ke liye karte hain, ghar banta hai aise palon se. Ghar Banta Hai Croma Se.
So this festive season, I decided to take that feeling to Croma and make something sweet for everyone who walked into the store!
